location_exception_reason: Prefabricated Structures are manufactured products with standardised specifications and nationwide delivery; location of manufacture or seller does not alter the product's structural, material, or performance characteristics. Buyers evaluate span, insulation, panel type, and IS code compliance — not origin geography.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words ('Manufacturer', 'Supplier', 'Dealer', 'Contractor') are redundant in titles because IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this information independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'PEB Shed Manufacturer' leaves a complete, accurate product title; the business relationship is not part of what is being sold.
